title: Elevate UI Design: Master CSS 'font-feature-settings' for Precision Web Typography
tweet: Unlock advanced typographic control! Discover how CSS 'font-feature-settings' transforms UI design, enhances readability, and delivers a polished user experience with web fonts. Perfect for precision typography. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UserExperience
tip: Harness the power of 'font-feature-settings' to activate OpenType features like true small caps ('smcp'), old-style figures ('onum'), or discretionary ligatures ('dlig'). This fine-grained control allows you to showcase the full potential of your web fonts, creating a sophisticated and highly legible UI that significantly boosts user experience.
css_snippet:
h1 { font-feature-settings: "liga" 1, "kern" 1; } /* Enable standard ligatures and kerning */
.small-caps { font-feature-settings: "smcp" 1; } /* Activate true small caps */
.old-style { font-feature-settings: "onum" 1; } /* Use old-style (lowercase) figures */
